name: Wish list
author: Lichtspiel
description: Everyone can search for movies and shows under Settings and wish for them; the wishes go to Radarr and Sonarr, and the list shows how they stand (wished, downloading, downloaded, here). What Radarr and Sonarr expect (release dates, new episodes) shows up under

. Enter the address (http://…:7878 / :8989) and API key (Settings → General in Radarr / Sonarr) of one or both. Optional: the quality profile and root folder by name (empty = the first), at most this many open wishes per person (0 = no limit), only admins may wish.
